title: Numbers in the Bible
lead: Some numbers in the Bible carry meaning beyond counting: seven for completeness (the seven days of Genesis 1), twelve for God's people (twelve tribes, twelve apostles), forty for testing (the flood, the wilderness, Jesus' fast), and Revelation's sevens, 666 and 144,000. How far to read numbers symbolically is debated, and gematria (number values of letters) is an old Jewish and Christian practice.
